# Commands and results

- `powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts\coverage-gate.ps1` exited 0. Reference fixtures, differential tests, simulated CDP matrix, unit, race and vet passed. Default internal, Frida-tagged internal, and smoke runner profiles each reported `total: (statements) 100.0%`.
- `powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts\build-windows.ps1` exited 0. Frida-tagged tests and packaging passed. EXE SHA-256 is `68A6367C4C8EED44CAFF7AF9E2DDC8910F3F6E8EDE1274C45E993AAAE9BAC480`; DLL SHA-256 is `BE79569BC2C764F72A37888A06635F7E6312C5155838D35F64C49BFAFBE42B90`.
- `powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts\smoke-windows.ps1 -UpstreamWaitSeconds 180 -ShutdownTimeoutSeconds 20` exited 0 on WMPF 25297. The Agent patched scene `1256` to `1101` and CDP filter `6` to `0`; the live seven-domain matrix returned `reconnect=true events=371`, and link smoke returned all three baseline commands true.
- The runner delivered `CTRL_BREAK_EVENT`; bridge output contained `stop-requested=true`, `child-exit-status=0`, and `child-exit-code=0`. The upstream peer survived, renderer PID 55016 remained responding after a delayed check, and both ports were released. No force fallback ran.

# Skipped checks

None.

# Spec consistency

The implementation and evidence cover the complete confirmed specification: Frida lifecycle, deterministic process/config selection, all 55 protobuf types, Codex and zlib semantics, CDP/context routing, differential fixtures, simulated multi-client proxy behavior, native Windows build, live CDP matrix, and graceful shutdown.

# Known limitations and risks

Windows is the first supported platform, and the live result is specific to installed WMPF version 25297. The repository has no initial Git commit, so Native cannot attribute every untracked path to a baseline; the user explicitly accepted partial scope `39c692cc84a1d6b656a81f78eb30aca25da8760b0a2161125a9f9e7c72e197d3`. This is an evidence-attribution limitation, not a skipped functional check.

# Conclusion

Fail for evidence refresh only. Functional checks passed, but revision 17 contains blocked Runtime receipts from partial-scope automated attempts; return to Build and re-enter Verify with a clean revision-bound manual evidence set.
